name: the-super-prime
description: Search luxury homes for sale and read global prime property research from The Super Prime.

interface.longDescription:
Founded and headquartered in London, The Super Prime is an independent publication covering the world's prime and super-prime real estate, from London to Lake Como, Dubai and Hong Kong.

Search luxury homes for sale listed on The Super Prime. Narrow by location, price, bedrooms, property type and features such as a pool, garden or lift.

Open any home for its asking price, size, tenure, key features, nearby transport and schools, photos, floorplan and brochure, along with the agency marketing it. Each result links to the full listing on thesuperprime.com, where you can view every photo and contact the agent.

Explore The Super Prime's global market news and research, from wealth trends to analysis of major agency reports, with a link to each full article.

The Super Prime is a publication, not an estate agency. This app is read-only: it shows published listings and articles, and does not book viewings, send enquiries or take payments.
defaultPrompt: Show me houses in Belgravia over £10M
What did The Super Prime say about the Savills PCL report?

positive.description: Search homes by area and minimum price
positive.prompt: Using The Super Prime, show me houses in Belgravia over £10M
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Belgravia houses (including townhouses) priced at £10M or more, with price, bedrooms, size and a link to each listing on thesuperprime.com.

positive.description: Exact bedroom count with a price ceiling
positive.prompt: Using The Super Prime, any 3-bed apartments in Knightsbridge under £8M?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns Knightsbridge apartments with exactly 3 bedrooms priced at or below £8M, with links. Says so clearly if none match.

positive.description: Full details and the marketing agent for one home
positive.prompt: Using The Super Prime, tell me about the Bourdon Street house in Mayfair. Who is the agent?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the price, size, tenure, key features, nearby stations and the agency and office marketing it, with the listing URL and brochure link.

positive.prompt: Using The Super Prime, find homes in London with 5 or more bedrooms and a swimming pool
positive.expected_behavior: Lists homes with 5+ bedrooms whose amenities include a pool, noting whether the pool is private or a shared residents' pool, with links.

positive.prompt: Using The Super Prime, what did you publish about the Savills prime central London report?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises The Super Prime's article on the Savills report (author, date, key points) and links to the full article.

negative.description: Booking or enquiry (the plugin is read-only)
negative.prompt: Using The Super Prime, book me a viewing of the Clarges Street penthouse for Saturday.
Using The Super Prime, put in an offer of £60M on the Clarges Street penthouse and pay the deposit.
What's the weather in Paris tomorrow?

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It shows published property listings and articles from thesuperprime.com.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: search The Super Prime's prime and super-prime property listings, open full listing details, and search and read The Super Prime's market research.
